_comment: Maps a mod folder to its Nexus Mods page. Only mods listed here can be released by
.github/workflows/release.yml -- the workflow's mod dropdown is built from this list.
mod_id  is the number in the mod page URL, e.g. nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14379
file_id is the ID of the EXISTING file on that page that new versions are added to.
Find it on the mod page's Files tab with the 'Advanced' toggle on, or in the
edit menu of Manage Files. The upload action adds a version to this file; it
cannot create a new mod page or a new file.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
